scope: Targeted artifact-confirmation evaluation with a faithful source screenshot and a controlled, newly typeset HTML line. Screening findings were seeded; this does not establish whole-book acceptance or customer latency. Private source images and PDF content are excluded.

evaluations.method: source comparison with explicit preservation wording
source comparison, preservation wording and actual PDF evidence

regression_coverage: Actual PDF text objects distinguish source bitmap lettering from newly typeset HTML.
Exact embedded source bytes and printed geometry are reported; unmatched images and unknown page geometry do not imply preservation.
Normal confirmation packets retain the four-image bound and carry PDF evidence into review records.
Introduced markup remains held; source observations retain spacing, clipping and reading-size review.
Review-policy hashing includes the PDF evidence helper.
limits: One positive and one negative live model control; broader corpus acceptance remains unproved.
The original complete-book result remains held; targeted evidence does not rewrite prior acceptance.
No deterministic artifact dismissal, source rewrite, quality-gate relaxation, email or deployment.
